clips.title: The story
paras: On Thunder Bluff’s lower rise, travelers find Innkeeper Pala tending the Cat and the Shaman. She offers a place to rest, cold drinks, and a hearthstone binding for journeys across Mulgore and beyond.

Innkeeper Pala tends the hearth at the Cat and the Shaman on Thunder Bluff’s lower rise. Travelers arrive from the central lifts or the plains of Mulgore. In the common room, weary warriors, wandering druids, and the Horde’s visiting allies can find shelter, a warm drink, and a familiar place to rest.
